slot.brief: Circuit diagram of series–parallel capacitors connected to a battery; reduce the network, find equivalent capacitance and the charge on a specific capacitor.

stem: A $12\ \text{V}$ battery is connected to the capacitor network as shown in the figure. What are its equivalent capacitance and the charge on the $6\ \mu\text{F}$ capacitor?

verdicts.working: The 3 μF and 6 μF capacitors are in parallel, giving 9 μF. This is in series with the other 3 μF, so C_eq = (3×9)/(3+9) = 2.25 μF. The parallel pair has 3 V across it, so the 6 μF capacitor has charge 6×3 = 18 μC.

working:
$C_{23}=3+6=9\ \mu\text{F}$; $C_{\mathrm{eq}}=\dfrac{3\times9}{3+9}=2.25\ \mu\text{F}$; $Q_{\mathrm{total}}=2.25\times12=27\ \mu\text{C}$; $V_{23}=27/9=3\ \text{V}$; $Q_6=6\times3=18\ \mu\text{C}$.

Independent check: The 3 μF and 6 μF capacitors are in parallel, giving 9 μF. This is in series with the other 3 μF, so C_eq = (3×9)/(3+9) = 2.25 μF. The parallel pair has 3 V across it, so the 6 μF capacitor has charge 6×3 = 18 μC.
solution:
The $3\,\mu\text{F}$ and $6\,\mu\text{F}$ capacitors are in parallel, and their combination is in series with the other $3\,\mu\text{F}$ capacitor.
$$C_{\mathrm{eq}}=\frac{3\times(3+6)}{3+(3+6)}=2.25\,\mu\text{F}$$
The parallel combination has voltage $V=27/9=3\,\text{V}$, so $Q_6=6\times3=18\,\mu\text{C}$.

draft.stem: A $12\ \text{V}$ battery is connected to the capacitor network as shown in the figure. What are its equivalent capacitance and the charge on the $6\ \mu\text{F}$ capacitor?

figure.description: Draw a 12 V battery in a left vertical branch between upper node A and lower node B, with its positive terminal connected to A. From A, draw a top horizontal wire passing through a 3 μF capacitor to a junction X. Connect two separate vertical branches from X to B, one containing a 3 μF capacitor and the other a 6 μF capacitor. Join the lower ends of both branches to B with wires. Label each capacitor with its capacitance and label the battery 12 V.

draft.distractor_notes: B assigns the total series charge to the 6 μF capacitor; C uses an incorrect reduction for the series combination; D treats the parallel branch as directly across the full battery.
